summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the SPARQL plugin. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra) beside Query. rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty-request path applies translatePrologue to the single declaration group q.prologue[0] and returns an empty algebra; Update is imported from sparql.py. rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) mirroring prepareQuery, including _original_args; processUpdate and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update are unchanged. rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. New test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers prepare-then-update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs resolution, direct evaluation, non-empty container shape, empty request, declarations-only request, and empty update string. Nothing was run and no commits were made; black formatting and test results are unverified. Initial-bindings behavior is not covered by a test.
